plan: SEARCH claims USING INDEX idx_recall_claims_scope_status (owner=? AND namespace=? AND status=? AND claim_id=?)
SEARCH d USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH text_recall_documents USING COVERING INDEX idx_text_recall_literal_fallback (owner=? AND namespace=? AND record_type=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
queries.sql: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.record_id FROM text_recall_fts CROSS JOIN text_recall_documents d ON d.doc_id = text_recall_fts.rowid WHERE text_recall_fts MATCH ? AND d.owner = ? AND d.namespace = ? AND d.record_type = ? UNION SELECT record_id FROM text_recall_documents WHERE owner = ? AND namespace = ? AND record_type = ? AND requires_literal_fallback=1) SELECT claim_id AS id, (CASE WHEN (instr(lower(subject), ?) > 0 OR instr(lower(predicate), ?) > 0 OR instr(lower(object), ?) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_terms FROM claims WHERE owner = ? AND namespace = ? AND status = 'active' AND claim_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM candidates) AND matched_terms > 0 ORDER BY matched_terms DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?

queries.sql: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.record_id FROM text_recall_fts CROSS JOIN text_recall_documents d ON d.doc_id = text_recall_fts.rowid WHERE text_recall_fts MATCH ? AND d.owner = ? AND d.namespace = ? AND d.record_type = ? UNION SELECT record_id FROM text_recall_documents WHERE owner = ? AND namespace = ? AND record_type = ? AND requires_literal_fallback=1) SELECT event_id AS id, (CASE WHEN (instr(lower(summary), ?) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_terms FROM events WHERE owner = ? AND namespace = ? AND event_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM candidates) AND matched_terms > 0 ORDER BY matched_terms DESC, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', substr(recorded_at, 1, 19) || CASE WHEN upper(substr(recorded_at, -1)) = 'Z' THEN 'Z' ELSE substr(recorded_at, -6) END) || '.' || CASE WHEN substr(recorded_at, 20, 1) = '.' THEN substr(substr(recorded_at, 21, length(recorded_at) - 20 - CASE WHEN upper(substr(recorded_at, -1)) = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 6 END) || '000000000', 1, 9) ELSE '000000000' END DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?
